name: drivin-tat
description: DRIVIN-TAT monorepo: Next.js frontend + Node.js (Express) backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run start -w frontend" "npm run start -w backend"
